requirements.scope_summary: This tender seeks a solution for a new digital platform, including portal development, back-office functionality, and a reference data repository, with specific requirements around API-first architecture, cloud hosting, and security standards. The project has a maximum duration of 32 weeks and a budget of 480,000 TND.
technical_constraints: Separation of environments and infrastructure as code
Cloud sovereign approved by the client; data primary hosted in Tunisia
TLS 1.3, AES-256 encryption at rest, MFA administrator, RBAC, and immutable logging
95% of interactive pages under 2 seconds with 1,000 concurrent users
contractual_constraints: Total amount not exceeding 480,000 TND TTC
Payments linked to formally accepted deliverables
PDF technical and financial submission documents
mandatory_requirements: Planning, governance and risk management (12 points)
